contentEn.title: Skol 225 – Beachfront studio in Marbella | Terrace & Pool

contentEn.description:
free wifi 

 

 A cosy one-bedroom studio located in the famous Skol building, right on the seafront in the heart of Marbella. An unbeatable location, surrounded by restaurants, shops and all amenities, making it the ideal place to enjoy your stay without needing a car. Studio of approximately 32m². 

 

 The apartment features a bright living room with an open-plan kitchen, fully equipped for your stay. The living area includes a comfortable sofa with chaise longue that converts into a sofa bed, a flat-screen TV, and direct access to the terrace. From here, you can enjoy pleasant partial sea views and an east-facing orientation, perfect for morning sunshine. 

 

 The bedroom is interior and features a double bed. At the entrance, there is a built-in wardrobe offering practical storage space. The open-plan kitchen comes with a cooking hob, microwave, fridge, coffee maker, toaster, and a breakfast bar with two stools, ideal for casual dining. The bathroom has been renovated and includes a modern walk-in shower. The Skol complex offers direct access to the beachfront promenade and the beach, as well as communal gardens and swimming pools, making it a perfect choice for a relaxing seaside holiday. 

 

 🌐 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely. 

 

 ❄ Private A/C. 

 

 🏊‍♀️ Among the Skol’s facilities are its three unheated outdoors community pools, open all year round. Sunbeds have a cost of €3 per day, and are occupied on a first-come-first-served basis. 

 

 🔑 Main reception open 24/7 to accommodate late arrivals. 

 

 ☕ Cafeteria open seasonally, with direct access to the promenade from the community gardens. 

 

 🛌 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach/pool towel) per guest included in the rental price. 

 

 🚗 Parking: The property does not have a private parking space. The nearest public car parks are Parking Arias Maldonado and El Molino , which can be booked through APK2 . Please note that APK2 is an independent external company and Marbella Skol is not responsible for its services, availability or pricing.

 

 Come and enjoy your holiday with the leader in vacation rentals in Marbella!
